title: The expansion of Heathrow would be an expensive disaster for Britain and the world. Burnham needs to block it | George Monbiot
summary: A third runway would fly in the face of reason. If we are to prioritise human life over short-term ‘growth’, we need to use planes less, not more, says Guardian columnist George Monbiot

If a third runway is built at Heathrow, what will be the impact on the wealth of the nation? It will cost us somewhere between £23.4bn and £62.5bn. These are not my figures; they weren’t calculated by environmental groups, but by the Department for Transport.

For decades, government ministers have told us that airport expansion is essential for “growth”. As chancellor, Rachel Reeves claimed that a third runway at Heathrow would add 0.43% to GDP, figures we later discovered came from a report commissioned by the airport. The transport department’s own analysis concluded that the real addition to GDP would be between 0.03% and 0.05%: eight to 14 times less. Against this, it weighed the social and environmental costs of the project, to reveal a massive net loss. It found that a third runway would cause major harm to the health and wellbeing of up to 3 million local people.
summary_zh: 第三條跑道將違背理性。衛報專欄作家喬治·蒙比奧特表示，如果我們要將人類生命置於短期「成長」之上，我們就需要減少而不是更多使用飛機
如果希思羅機場建造第三條跑道，將對國家財富產生什麼影響？我們將花費 234 億至 625 億英鎊。這些不是我的人物；它們不是由環保組織計算的，而是由交通部計算的。

幾十年來，政府部長們一直告訴我們，機場擴建對於「成長」至關重要。身為財政大臣，雷切爾·里夫斯 (Rachel Reeves) 聲稱希思羅機場第三條跑道將為 GDP 增加 0.43%，我們後來發現的數字來自機場委託的一份報告。交通部門自己的分析得出的結論是，GDP 的實際增量將在 0.03% 至 0.05% 之間：少 8 至 14 倍。與此相對，它權衡了該項目的社會和環境成本，揭示了巨大的淨損失。研究發現，第三條跑道將對多達 300 萬當地人的健康和福祉造成重大損害。
